```renyi
public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  if arguments.is_empty() then
    return Help
  end

  let first be arguments.first() otherwise ""
  match first
    when "add" then
      let task_words be arguments.without_index(0)
      let task be task_words.join(" ")
      return Add(task: task)
    when "done" then
      if arguments.length is at least 2 then
        let position_text be arguments.at(1) otherwise ""
        let position be position_text.to_integer() otherwise 0
        if position is at least 1 then
          return Done(position: position)
        end
      end
      return Help
    when "show" then
      return Show
    otherwise
      return Help
  end
end
```
